content: A coherent small-mod architecture is a single monolith with vertical packages, a thin common bootstrap, one immutable configuration snapshot, one campaign service/state machine, a reusable boss base with phase definitions, and modules registered through a tiny interface. Keep all world mutation on the logical server; send only presentation cues to the client. Load dialogue and encounter definitions through current resource reload APIs and Codecs, while keeping attack mechanics in Java for predictability.
